findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the event and the traffic spikes, but does not explicitly link the event as the cause of the surge.
The evidence explicitly states the event details, location, attendance, and time window.
The alert text lists all five metrics (active users, dl_volume, drop_rate, latency, prb_util) as spiking on the three sites.
The T2 output explicitly states the earliest onset was 18:30 on S-TUN-001 dl_volume_mb.
The cited alarms are VSWR_HIGH (hardware) and HIGH_PRB (congestion), both occurring within the event window.
